recipes.title: Approval remote
recipes.description: Review a versioned proposal, approve or request changes, and follow the outcome.

recipes.title: Field notebook
recipes.description: Keep durable observations with photos, reviewed locations, interpretations, search and export.

recipes.title: Hands-free task guide
recipes.description: Follow stable steps, hear instructions, attach evidence and resume from saved checkpoints.

recipes.title: Multi-device workshop
recipes.description: Give devices explicit purposes, share a camera view and annotated steps, and move audio focus.

recipes.title: Hardware experiment companion
recipes.description: Plot serial or simulated readings, record interventions, interpret a run and export its report.

recipes.title: Facilitated group session
recipes.description: Collect private participant answers and publish a deliberately shared group summary.

recipes.title: Voice coach
recipes.description: Optional wake phrase and audible cues for hands-free requests; send longer voice notes too.

recipes.title: Motion companion
recipes.description: Measure a movement session and ask the agent to interpret its summary.

recipes.title: Photo inspector
recipes.description: Capture an object and ask a question about it.

recipes.title: Collaborative canvas
recipes.description: Give the agent drawings and choices from an editable interface.

recipes.title: Explore this device
recipes.description: Live capability gallery with working input controls.

recipes.title: Adaptive check-in
recipes.description: Agent reshapes the page through shared state UI blocks.
